title: Tiamat's Wrath
author: James S. A. Corey
summary: The eighth Expanse novel is set under the rule of a new, powerful empire that now controls the settled worlds. A scattered resistance tries to hit back, and the old crew pursues its own risky plans. It needs the earlier books.
readIf: you are following the Expanse and want its story to keep tightening toward the endgame.
skipIf: you are new to the series, as this is far along and spoils a lot.

pairings.reason: Another space opera about empire and the control of people, with a very different, cooler voice.
A short, funny science-fiction story with a sardonic android narrator, for a break from heavy war.
A fast, humane science-fiction novel about humans fighting in space against hostile species.
